Result<String> {\n        // Spawn the binary with version command\n        let output = Command::new(binary_path)\n            .args(version_command)\n            .stdout(Stdio::piped())\n            .stderr(Stdio::piped())\n            .output()\n            .with_context(|| {\n                format!(\n                    \"failed to spawn binary '{}' for version check\",\n
